---BEGIN MEMO---
To: Sarah Bennett (VP Sales), Miguel Alvarez (CFO)
From: Marissa Cole (AE)
Re: Helix Health — approval to offer refundable commitment deposit + 3-yr price-lock with 5% annual uplift cap

Summary:
Helix Health is negotiating a 3-year commitment (estimated $3.6M TCV). Procurement requests a price-lock mechanism for years 1–3 and a renewal protection clause. Legal is receptive to price table language; Finance objects to third-party escrow due to revenue complexity.

Proposal:
- Contract will include explicit year-by-year unit pricing (Year1/Year2/Year3) with a maximum 5% uplift year-over-year.
- Add renewal protection: a 30-day notice window guaranteeing the ability to renew at committed tier pricing for an additional 12 months if exercised.
- Offer a refundable commitment deposit (held by Redwood) sized at 2 months' equivalent committed spend; credited to Helix as usage credits or refunded if Helix meets termination-for-cause thresholds.

Risks / Mitigations:
- Revenue recognition and refund liability: Finance will model the deposit as a liability and provide reserve guidance; refund triggers will be tightly scoped.
- Competitive leakage: lock reduces our ability to capture future price increases — mitigated by explicit carve-outs for new feature charges and add-on services.

Ask:
Executive authorization to: a) approve the refundable deposit pattern in lieu of third-party escrow for this strategic 3-yr deal, and b) approve the 5% max uplift and renewal protection language.

Timeline:
Decision requested by COB Wed 2026-10-14.

---END MEMO---

If OK, I'll route to Sarah + Miguel and copy Legal.

—Marissa
